entry_proxy: open of the 15:49 start-stamped minute bar
exit_proxy: close of the 15:50 start-stamped minute bar
execution_buffer: one full minute between the final feature bar and the 15:49 entry proxy
primary_definition: retain all additions and true Standard exits; require expected-direction relative one-hour momentum for down-to-small deletions
weighting: retain frozen Top-10 weights, scale only the larger surviving leg down to preserve dollar neutrality, never redistribute above the original 10% name cap
primary_metric: mean net return per scheduled review at 10 bp
familywise_control: four-review block sign-flip max-t across the mechanism-extension family

walk_forward.objective: highest historical mean net return per scheduled review

retrospective_split.warning: post-first-pass exploratory extension, not an untouched holdout

tight_cutoff_sensitivity: not applicable to the migration-aware primary rule
future_validation: only a rule meeting the predeclared hit-rate and return-retention constraints may be frozen for the next eight reviews
